changes.sourceKey: units = labs × included HPLCs per lab. Initial investment = units × (equipment + installation). Annual net operating cash saving = material saving + disposal saving − annual support. Net benefit over N years = N × annual net saving − initial investment. ROI = net benefit ÷ initial investment. NPV = −initial investment + sum of annual net saving ÷ (1 + discount rate)^year. Upfront payment occurs at year 0; operating cash flows occur at each year end. Simple payback assumes evenly accruing monthly savings. Labour capacity value is excluded from cash returns.
